comment: Parse agreement of the two readers of the parity allowlist and tests/parity/lock_cells.txt: scripts/ci/parity_ratchet.py (parse_allowlist, parse_lock_cells; the runtime ratchet) and tests/conformance/registry (ParseAllowlist, ParseLockCells, ParityDataProblems; the registry gate). `python` and `go` are each reader's outcome: the parsed entries (allowlist: the test paths; lock cells: name -> floor) or "reject". Each reader's test asserts its OWN outcome; both tests assert the invariant: when both readers accept an input they return the same entries, and a one-sided rejection is allowed because it fails closed (a rejecting ratchet fails the parity job, a rejecting gate fails the pull request). The Go allowlist reader reports "reject" for the byte-level refusals of ParityDataProblems; it has no other error path.

allowlist.name: a plain entry
a tab before the separator
a tab-separated reason after spaces
trailing spaces and a trailing tab
a subtest path with a # suffix
a NBSP (U+00A0) before the separator
an em space (U+2003) before the separator
an ideographic space (U+3000) before the separator
a leading NBSP on an entry line
a leading ideographic space on a comment line
a line of only Unicode spaces is blank
a Unicode space INSIDE the name: Python refuses, Go reads the first word
two words before the separator: Python refuses, Go reads the first
no space before the #: Python sees no reason and refuses, Go reads one word
an empty reason: Python refuses
a duplicate entry: Python refuses, Go keeps the set
allowlist.text:
TestA  # B1: one
TestA  # B2: two

allowlist.name: an Arabic-Indic digit in min-pass: Python refuses (ASCII digits only)
a signed min-pass: Python refuses
an underscore in min-pass: Python refuses
two min-pass directives: Python refuses
CRLF line endings: both refuse the bytes
a lone CR hides an entry from a line splitter: both refuse
allowlist.text: TestA  # B1: reasonTestB  # B2: reason

allowlist.name: a U+2028 hides an entry: both refuse
allowlist.text: TestA  # B1: reason TestB  # B2: reason

allowlist.name: a NEL (U+0085): both refuse
allowlist.text: TestA  # B1: reasonTestB  # B2: reason

allowlist.name: a BOM: both refuse
an empty file
only comments

lock_cells.name: an em space and an ideographic space
an Arabic-Indic digit: Python's isdigit accepts it, Go's Atoi refuses
a plus sign: Go's Atoi accepts it, Python refuses
a non-ASCII test name: Python's \w accepts it, Go's pattern refuses
a name that is not a Test: both refuse
a U+2028 hides a cell: both refuse the bytes
